items.name: Origin Cape
items.blurb: The three rings, stitched in silver on dark folded cloth.

items.name: Origin+ Cape
items.blurb: Members only. Satin-black cloth, silver trim, the three rings and a stitched plus.

items.name: Void Cape
items.blurb: A black hole rift in violet-black cloth, ringed in light, under a scatter of stars.

items.name: Inferno Cape
items.blurb: Charred black cloth with living flames licking up from a glowing hem.

items.name: Aurora Cape
items.blurb: A rippling green, teal and violet aurora over a starry night and a dark pine horizon.

items.name: Starfall Cape
items.blurb: A deep navy night with a slow meteor shower and twinkling stars.

items.name: Orbit Cape
items.blurb: Electrons circle the three rings of the Origin mark.

items.name: Glitch Cape
items.blurb: A clean Origin mark that tears and splits in brief digital bursts.

items.name: Frost Cape
items.blurb: Teal cloth, frost ferns creeping up from the hem, ice glinting in the light.

items.name: Golden Hour Cape
items.blurb: A low sun, a violet-to-gold sky and layered pine ridges, painted on the cloth.

items.name: Ember Wings
items.blurb: Obsidian wings with fire running through the veins. Hides your cape; a few embers drift off as you move.

items.name: Origin Bandana
items.blurb: Charcoal cloth over the nose and mouth, knotted at the back.

items.name: Visor Mask
items.blurb: A slim smoked-glass visor across the eyes.

items.name: Pixel Crown
items.blurb: A small gold crown with four pearl-tipped points, an engraved scroll band and cut gems. Low enough to see over.

items.name: Emerald
items.blurb: Deep jewel green: cool forest shadows, ivory text, a bright emerald accent.

items.name: Crimson
items.blurb: Dark wine surfaces with a warm cream voice and a vivid crimson accent.

items.name: Ocean
items.blurb: Midnight navy panels with soft sea-glass text and a calm sky-blue accent.

items.name: Rose
items.blurb: Dusky violet-black with blush text and a soft rose-pink accent.
